question: Should this release intentionally remove externally reachable Matrix webhook ingress until provider-native authentication exists, or must the branch preserve an upgrade-compatible Matrix path?
rationale: The patch closes an unauthenticated ingress boundary, but Matrix has no credential users can add to retain current public reachability, so security policy and upgrade compatibility cannot both be inferred from code alone.

options.title: Approve Loopback-Only Matrix
options.body: Accept the fail-closed boundary, but require explicit migration guidance, doctor diagnostics, and upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Defer Matrix Enforcement
options.body: Keep the other provider hardening while removing the Matrix constructor restriction until an authenticated ingress design is available.

options.title: Add Authenticated Matrix Ingress
options.body: Implement and verify a provider-native authenticated Matrix transport before disabling the existing public path.

recommendation.title: Approve Loopback-Only Matrix
recommendation.body: Accept the fail-closed boundary, but require explicit migration guidance, doctor diagnostics, and upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the exact-head cross-provider security design and have the most direct context for the intended Matrix boundary.
